summary: This summer I will get students who have had wordpress.com for three of my previous classrooms. The tool anxiety and the 1/2 semester it takes to learn the blogging workflow should be something to reflect on and not worry about. Trust is hard with change.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: This summer I will get students who have had wordpress.com for three of my previous classrooms. The tool anxiety and the 1/2 semester it takes to learn the blogging workflow should be something to reflect on and not worry about. Trust is hard with change.
